s: This article explores the practical integration of AI assistants into software development, focusing on agentic coding practices, strategic documentation for AI, and managing complex APIs like Botify. It highlights the shift towards standardized AI protocols (MCP) and Git as a safety net for human-AI collaboration.
sub: Agentic Coding and AI interaction modes (Agent, Manual, Ask)
Strategic documentation for AI understanding of minimalist design patterns (Nix, FastHTML, HTMX)
Managing complexity with Botify API and embracing Git for AI development safety
The role of MCP (Model Context Protocol) in standardizing AI interaction and agentic workflows
